en_title: Dungeons & Dragons Movie Sequel Has a Script But 'Financial Reasons' Might Keep It from Ever Coming Out
cn_title: 《龙与地下城：侠盗荣耀》续集已有剧本却难获开拍
subtitle: 口碑挡不住财务现实

paragraphs.en: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves co-director Jonathan Goldstein says the script for a sequel already exists, but he's not expecting it to see the light of day any time soon.
paragraphs.cn: 《龙与地下城：侠盗荣耀》联合导演乔纳森·戈尔茨坦表示，续集剧本已经完成，但他不认为这部电影近期有机会问世。

paragraphs.en: The filmmaker behind the 2023 D&D adaptation gave fans an unfortunate update when speaking with ScreenRant at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) 2026. Fans praised the original movie for how it faithfully brought the classic tabletop roleplaying game to the big screen, but it doesn't sound like its favorable reception from critics and audiences will do much to bring a sequel to life.
paragraphs.cn: 这位2023年D&D改编电影的主创在2026年圣迭戈国际动漫展（SDCC）接受ScreenRant采访时，向粉丝透露了这个遗憾消息。原片因忠实地将经典桌面角色扮演游戏搬上大银幕而获得粉丝称赞，但评论界与观众的良好反馈，似乎不足以让续集真正落地。

paragraphs.en: "We actually wrote a sequel to Dungeons and Dragons," Goldstein said. "We were hired to write it. I don't know that it will see the light of day for a number of financial reasons. They're expensive movies to make, but it'd be great fun to do it. We love that cast, and we think we wrote something that fans would like."
paragraphs.cn: 戈尔茨坦说：「我们确实写了一部《龙与地下城》续集。有人聘请我们完成了剧本，但出于多方面的财务原因，我不知道它是否有机会面世。这类电影制作成本很高，不过拍起来肯定非常有趣。我们很喜欢原班演员，也相信自己写出了粉丝会喜欢的故事。」

paragraphs.en: Those "financial reasons" he mentioned are probably a reference to Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves' box office returns. Despite rolling into its opening weekend as the number one movie in theaters domestically , its final global total saw it bring in just $205.46 million (via Box Office Mojo ). It’s a respectable enough finish on its own, but considering Variety reported the film cost $150 million before factoring in marketing costs, things could have gone much, much better for the D&D movie .
paragraphs.cn: 他提到的「财务原因」很可能指《龙与地下城：侠盗荣耀》的票房表现。影片首周末曾登顶北美院线票房榜，但最终全球总票房仅为2.0546亿美元(约合人民币14亿元)。单看这个成绩尚算体面，可《综艺》报道称影片在不计营销费用前的制作成本就达到1.5亿美元(约合人民币10亿元)，因此这部D&D电影原本需要取得好得多的表现。

paragraphs.en: Still, the fact a sequel script was written suggests someone at Paramount was interested in keeping the story going at some point. The original film – which starred Chris Pine (Edgin), Michelle Rodriguez (Holga), Justice Smith (Simon), Sophia Lillis (Doric), Hugh Grant (Forge), and Regé-Jean Page (Xenk) – has certainly managed to garner a group of die-hard fans since its premiere.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，续集剧本能够完成，说明派拉蒙内部至少曾有人有意延续这个故事。原片由克里斯·派恩（饰埃德金）、米歇尔·罗德里格兹（饰霍尔盖）、贾斯蒂斯·史密斯（饰西蒙）、索菲娅·莉莉丝（饰多立克）、休·格兰特（饰弗奇）和雷吉-让·佩吉（饰赞克）主演，上映后确实吸引了一批忠实粉丝。

paragraphs.en: Its Rotten Tomatoes scores, for example, sit at 91% from critics and 92% from fans. IGN gave the film a 7/10 review , calling it an "accessible fantasy adventure that both roasts and respects D&D culture without losing newcomers along for the ride."
paragraphs.cn: 例如，影片在烂番茄获得91%的媒体评分和92%的观众评分。IGN在7/10分评测中称其为一场「平易近人的奇幻冒险，既调侃又尊重D&D文化，同时也没有把新观众落在后面」。

paragraphs.en: With a script on the table and Paramount going through its own changes every day, it's unclear if Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves sequel will ever come to be. Former Paramount Pictures CEO Brian Robbins had previously stated he would be interested in doing a second movie, but only if it could be made "for less." Pine, meanwhile, said in 2023 that he was "pretty confident" it would happen eventually.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管剧本已经摆在桌上，派拉蒙自身却每天都在经历变化，因此《龙与地下城：侠盗荣耀》续集是否会真正诞生仍不明朗。派拉蒙影业前CEO布莱恩·罗宾斯此前表示，他有兴趣制作第二部，但前提是能以「更低成本」完成。与此同时，派恩曾在2023年表示，他「相当有信心」续集最终会实现。

summary: 《龙与地下城：侠盗荣耀》续集剧本已经完成，但联合导演乔纳森·戈尔茨坦称高昂制作成本和首部电影有限的票房回报，可能让项目无法开拍。原片虽获91%媒体与92%观众烂番茄评分，全球票房却仅约2.05亿美元。
opus_summary: 续集不是没有故事，而是算不过账。剧本早已写好，但首部电影1.5亿美元(约合人民币10亿元)成本对应2.05亿美元(约合人民币14亿元)全球票房，让派拉蒙很难批准同等规模的新片。
